name: Szigetbecse (Hungary)
description: White field with blue horizontal stripes near the top and along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szigetbecse: a blue and white shield with a white bend, a wavy stripe and a snake, inscribed SZIGETBECSE on a yellow chief.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
